description: The file defines the AdcDevice class, including its data members and member functions related to ADC hardware configuration and value retrieval. It sets up the interface for ADC interaction in embedded firmware.

classes.name: AdcDevice
classes.description: A class encapsulating ADC device configuration, enabling, and data access methods in embedded firmware.

methods.name: AdcDevice
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ADC device with specified hardware configuration.

methods.name: enableChannelAndPin
methods.description: Enables ADC channel and configures its associated pin.

methods.name: getAdcHardwareIndexByInternalIndex
methods.description: Returns the hardware ADC channel index corresponding to an internal index.

methods.name: isHwUsed
methods.description: Checks if a specific ADC hardware channel is in use.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of ADC channels.

methods.name: getAdcValueByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the ADC value for a given internal index.

methods.name: getAdcValueByHwChannel
methods.description: Retrieves the ADC value for a specific hardware channel.
